id: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader (2010)

facts.text: Reepicheep on watch, Eustace writing his diary.
facts.why: Eustace narrates 'Dear diary' entries aboard the ship, complaining about sharing quarters with the mouse, Reepicheep.
